edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information or documents protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, or any other applicable protection. Defendant’s objections are subject to and do not waive any applicable protection.

edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production as set forth in the individual responses below. Defendant will state for each request whether it will produce responsive documents, whether responsive documents are being withheld on the basis of an objection, or whether no responsive documents have been identified after a reasonable inquiry. These responses are based on information presently available and are subject to supplementation as required by the applicable rules.
edits.name: Request-specific preliminary statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to a request only to the extent stated in the response to that request. Any assertion of attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, or other applicable protection will be identified in the applicable response, and documents withheld on that basis will be identified in a privilege log to the extent required by the applicable rules or agreement. No objection is intended to waive an applicable protection.
edits.name: Narrow general objections

edits.text: 2. INDIVIDUAL RESPONSES AND PRODUCTION. For each request, Defendant will state its response and any specific objection, identify whether responsive documents are being withheld on the basis of that objection, and describe the production, if any. Defendant will state the anticipated completion date for production once confirmed.
edits.name: Request-specific responses and timing

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. For documents withheld on the basis of privilege or other applicable protection, Defendant will provide a privilege log to the extent required by the applicable rules or agreement.
edits.name: Privilege log
